learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Security advisory permissions are now generally available
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog feed fetched 2026-11-21 lists as newest item: "Security advisory permissions are now generally available" (Fri, 20 Nov 2026 21:49:29 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The system plan should review existing organizational role assignments and incorporate these fine-grained security advisory permissions to delegate advisory management exclusively to authorized security team members.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
